summary: Phone agent framework from Z.ai that looks at an Android or HarmonyOS screen and taps through apps to finish tasks you describe in plain language.

heroCommands.command: python main.py --base-url http://localhost:8000/v1 "Open Maps and search for nearby coffee shops"

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: Open-AutoGLM's Phone Agent is a mobile assistant framework built on the AutoGLM vision-language model. It reads the phone screen, plans the next step and operates the device through ADB (Android) or HDC (HarmonyOS). You describe a task like 'Open eBay and search for wireless earphones' and it carries out the whole flow, asking for confirmation on sensitive operations.
sixtySeconds.problem: Automating phone apps normally means writing brittle scripts. Phone Agent understands the screen and acts like a person would.
whoFor: Developers testing Android or HarmonyOS apps
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for an open phone-agent framework with its own models, third-party hosted options and remote (wireless) debugging support.
requirements: ADB (Android 7.0+) or HDC (HarmonyOS) with developer mode and USB debugging on
ADB Keyboard on Android for text input
A model endpoint: z.ai, Novita AI, Parasail, or self-hosted

overview: Set up Python, install ADB or HDC, enable developer mode and USB debugging on the phone, and on Android install ADB Keyboard. Then install the project's requirements.

Point it at a model service: a third-party host such as z.ai (model autoglm-phone-multilingual) with your own API key, or deploy the model yourself. Then run main.py with a task or in interactive mode.
The README states it is for research and learning only and forbids illegal use. It is Apache 2.0 licensed.
limitations: Setup needs developer mode on the phone

steps.title: Prepare the phone
steps.body: Enable developer mode and USB debugging; on Android install ADB Keyboard.

steps.title: Choose a model service
steps.body: Use a hosted option such as z.ai with --base-url https://api.z.ai/api/paas/v4, --model autoglm-phone-multilingual and your API key, or deploy the model yourself.

steps.title: Run a task
steps.code: python main.py --base-url http://localhost:8000/v1 "Open Maps and search for nearby coffee shops"

firstRun.title: Try interactive mode
firstRun.body: Run main.py with your base URL and model and type a task.

tutorial.title: Have the agent search in an app
tutorial.useCase: Run a simple task on an Android phone.

steps.title: Check the device
steps.body: Make sure adb sees your phone.

steps.title: Run the task
steps.code: python main.py --base-url http://localhost:8000/v1 "Open Maps and search for nearby coffee shops"

steps.title: Watch and confirm
steps.body: Approve any sensitive steps it asks about.

tutorial.expected: The phone opens Maps and shows nearby coffee shops.
